items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: I knew him slightly, but not personally as such.

ctx.x: He lived on the West Bank there for a while. He was a good friend of Mineta. He and Mineta were very, very good friends. That's another tremendous character, Mineta. He was from over in Algiers in the West Bank of the River. Did you know Mineta? I knew him slightly, but not personally as such. I'm trying to think of Clarence's name. Clarence and I went to Hoffman High School after I left the Mac down to 35. Clarence was a trumpet player who lived over in the Algiers. I'm trying to think of Clarence's last name.…
